reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, pp.promo_id
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Basswell'
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, pp.promo_id FROM promotion_products pp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Basswell'
SELECT products.product_name, promotion_products.promo_id FROM products LEFT OUTER JOIN promotion_products ON promotion_products.product_id = products.product_id WHERE products.brand = 'Basswell'

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, pp.promo_id FROM promotion_products pp RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Basswell'
